explanation: Eta channel (ep->ep eta) with 25 kinematic points. W=1.6 GeV is just above eta threshold (1.487 GeV), Q2=1.0 GeV2, cos(theta*)=0. All parameters valid; no physical impossibility. Because EXCLURAD Fortran input reader is limited to 10 points per file (README/examples), the 25-point phi sweep (0 to 345 deg in 25 steps = step 14.375 deg) is split into 3 chunk files: 10 + 10 + 5 points. Chunking applies correct eta settings (model 3 / maid2000, rc_mode 0 full O(alpha), bmom 6.53, ivc 1 proton, vcut 0.166 GeV2). Warning: runs near threshold often cause NAG integration failure (ifail=2) as seen in template outputs; if errors occur, use run_exclurad_skip_unphys.sh or inspect all.dat for unphysical skips. No input corrections needed; output artifacts (all.dat etc.) will be produced in working directory when executed.
